scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONT,BACK -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vale-a-compra/contracts && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n FRONT,BACK -c green,cyan "npm run start -w frontend" "npm run start -w backend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.railway:build:backend: npm run build -w @vale-a-compra/contracts && npm run build -w backend
scripts.railway:build:frontend: npm run build -w @vale-a-compra/contracts && npm run build -w frontend
